role: The netty ByteToMessageDecoder that reads a packet's varint id, instantiates the packet from the channel's receivable map, reads its body and feeds it to the handler.
scope_reason: Wire format and connection plumbing: native messages are structs by design (SPEC: messages are structs, not bytes) (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

members.name: decode
members.note: no byte channel exists natively; packet ids and bodies are handled as structs

missing: The varint-id decode and packet instantiation from a byte buffer are not ported; csrc/engine/clientworld.c consumes packet structs directly (clientworld_handle_packet), and csrc/engine/tracker.h enumerates packet kinds as an enum instead of bytes.
notes: The oracle's real netty channel is replaced by lockstep packet structs; SPEC's lockstep counts sends/receives, not wire bytes, so the framing codec has nothing to mirror.
